questions.text: My Coupa requisition shows Pending next to my director's name. What does that mean, and what can I do?

Approvers have 3 business days to act. If your director is out of office, ask your manager to approve on their behalf or contact Procurement & AP to reroute it. Don’t create a duplicate requisition while this one is pending.
